title: In accordance with the provisions of Chapter 25, Section 18 of the Massachusetts General Laws, as amended by Chapter 99, Section 4, the Department of Telecommunications and Energy hereby makes an assessment on the Intra-State Revenues of electric, gas, cable television, and telephone companies in the amount of $9,080,439.36 for FY 1999.
filings: ORDER Issued. By Commissioners Besser, Connelly (wrk), Keating, Vasington and Sullivan. DTE 99-55.
